summary: Coeur d'Alene NF lookout on Griffith Peak, Shoshone County, ID: a 30-foot L-4 tower dated 1934, destroyed 1953; a 1926 fire had burned an earlier lookout there.

facts.status_note: Destroyed 1953 per Firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts; no source describes what remains

access.note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as drive-up; no source says whether it is open to visitors today

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as drive-up; no trail is described

events.note: Independence Creek fire burned out the Griffith Peak lookout and its telephone line (July 1926 newspaper item quoted on Forest Lookouts)
30-foot pole tower with L-4 cab; may have replaced the lookout that burned in 1926, which no source describes
Leonine Garnett, 18, reported on duty on Griffith Peak (October 7, 1945 newspaper item)

evidence.supports: 1934 pole L-4 tower in Idaho Fire Lookouts history
1926 fire burned out the lookout and telephone line
evidence.quote: burned out the Griffith Peak lookout and telephone line.

evidence.supports: Leonine Garnett, 18, on Griffith Peak; 5,800 feet
evidence.quote: Leonine Garnett, 18, who is up on Griffith Peak, 5,800 feet, and 60 miles from Coeur d'Alene

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 4,589 feet; the 1945 newspaper item quoted on Forest Lookouts gives 5,800 feet. The story reports both; neither is confirmed.

notes_for_editor: Brief lists only the 1953 destruction. Sources show a lookout burned in July 1926, so the 1934 tower was not the first; no source says whether it replaced the earlier one. Elevation conflicts (4,589 vs 5,800 ft). No source describes the site today. Lakeview is given without a state by Firelookout.com. The web search found no further source.
